title: Upload
subtitle: Pick a repository and a folder, tick what goes up, upload — and forget about it. No workspace, no history to manage.
note: .gitignore, node_modules, target, .git and other junk are skipped automatically. Files over 25 MB can't be uploaded this way. Everything goes up as one commit.
startBody: Choose a repository, a branch and a folder on the left. Every file is compared with GitHub — new and changed ones are ticked for you.
emptyRepo: empty repository — this becomes the first commit
noFiles: This folder has no files to upload
allSameBody: No file differs from the repository. Tick "Show unchanged" to upload some anyway.
tooLarge_one: {{count}} file is over 25 MB and is left out: {{list}}
tooLarge_other: {{count}} files are over 25 MB and are left out: {{list}}
truncated: Only the first {{count}} files are listed.
